summary: Join our Biodiversity and Ecosystem Management in Agriculture Course. Discover strategies to promote sustainability and biodiversity in farming practices.
lede: Biodiversity and ecosystem management in agriculture helps agricultural professionals assess the living systems that support farming. For farm managers, agronomists, sustainability officers and environmental advisers, it provides practical ways to map biodiversity and ecosystem services, identify pressures, and plan soil, water and habitat actions. Learners also develop indicators, monitoring templates and reporting outputs to guide farm decisions and track improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage agricultural land, biodiversity-related risks, ecosystem-service decisions, and sustainability reporting across farm and landscape settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of agricultural operations, land management, or sustainability reporting. Prior exposure to biodiversity concepts, soil health, farm planning, or environmental management will help, but no coding is required. You should be ready to review sample field data, map biodiversity risks, and work with practical templates for monitoring, action planning, and reporting.
